brief: Use case: ads-marketing / premium outdoor club brand identity. Create ONE finished flat horizontal banner design, edge-to-edge artwork, landscape 3:1 aspect ratio, preferably 3072x1024. This is a serious identity exploration by a Korean brand designer with 15 years experience: exceptional optical kerning, strong proprietary logo idea, restrained composition, distance legibility, editorial typography, beautiful negative space and mature art direction. Not a mockup: no room, no hanging fabric, no wrinkles, no eyelets, no presentation board, no multiple options. All content comfortably inside 5% safe margins. The Korean headline must be flawless and exactly as specified. Exact supporting Korean tagline once: '함께 가는 길, 함께 오르는 산'. Exact founding text once: 'SINCE 2021'. Small English 'HAMSAN' or 'HAMSAN OUTDOOR CLUB' is allowed. No other Korean text, no '시산제', no other year, no invented location or altitude, no sponsor logos, no stock watermarks. Do not print variant numbers or explanatory labels. Make the primary Korean name dominate. Use only three or four deliberate text levels. No generic website UI, no template clipart.
concepts: Deep evergreen and warm ivory. Create a striking abstract emblem of two ascending trails joining into a geometric mountain, on the left quarter. Across the center-right, one massive, impeccably kerned Korean geometric sans headline on ONE line. Thin acid lime accent rule. Tagline below headline. Very small English and year at opposite top corners. Technical luxury, minimalist Swiss outdoor identity.

Bone white background, charcoal black typography, tiny vermilion sun. Entire banner feels like an exquisitely typeset literary mountain journal: large custom Korean high-contrast serif name spanning center, extremely fine etched mountain ridge under title, year as small serif upper-right, airy centered tagline. No badge. Quiet premium heritage.

Bold electric cobalt typography on clean pale stone. Huge compact Korean bespoke angular display logotype across width, integrate a small triangular summit negative-space cut in one stroke without hurting Korean legibility. Asymmetric flush-left layout, small black HAMSAN bottom left, tagline bottom right; fine climbing-route stroke in right margin. Contemporary technical sports identity, no slant rectangle templates.

Sophisticated field notebook composition, warm parchment with dark olive ink, an ultra-fine technically accurate contour-map field confined to right 32%, not behind text. Name in large heavy Korean grotesk on left 65% one line. Oversized minimalist route-point symbol in map. Tiny editorial labels 'FIELD NOTES' and HAMSAN, generous whitespace, orange single route accent. Professional cartographic identity.

Near-black background, snow-white name, elegant central symmetrical mountaintop emblem above wide-spaced custom Korean headline. Tiny silver-grey contour lines sweeping only extreme edges. Crisp rectangular thin white frame inset. Tagline centered below. High-end monochrome outdoor equipment brand; flat restrained precise geometry.

Saturated rescue orange base with dense black oversized Korean type. Ultra-bold typographic composition split 70/30: large club name on left, abstract black wayfinding arrow icon in right. Fine cream divider rule. Top micro English HAMSAN OUTDOOR CLUB, year tucked beneath icon. Strong but sophisticated European mountaineering label, no gradient.

Beautiful editorial dawn photograph of many Korean granite mountain ridges through light atmospheric mist, cool desaturated steel blue, wide panoramic horizontal crop. Large immaculate ivory Korean sans name in clear dark upper-middle field, tagline smaller beneath, slim white vertical tick and HAMSAN upper-left. Very subtle photographic treatment, brand not travel flyer.

Cream background with one deep oxblood climbing rope making an elegant abstract infinity and mountain knot on left quarter. Rope rendered photoreal with tactile braid, spacious elegant Korean bold sans logotype on right two-thirds in oxblood. Small 'HAMSAN' in letterspaced serif, year under knot. Gallery-like sophisticated material-led brand identity.

Midnight navy and pale butter yellow. Create clever proprietary minimal tent and mountain shelter icon using simple confident strokes on left; a tiny warm orange aperture. Monumental rounded Korean logotype on right. Tagline in warm yellow. Calm friendly premium outdoors brand with editorial alignment; no cute mascot.

Ivory background, burgundy and dark moss. A single broad ribbon line climbing in three decisive folds across bottom third like an abstract ridge, sparse flat graphic architecture. Huge dark burgundy Korean typography upper-left, year top right. Distinctive composed Swiss graphic banner, text never overlaps ribbon.

Sophisticated 1960s national park screenprint, limited palette of pine green, rust, ochre and cream. Stylized monumental Korean granite peak in right third, a few graphic pine silhouettes and river path, rich print texture. Left two-thirds for beautiful bold Korean name, tiny classic HAMSAN type and founding year. Mature collectible park poster composed as horizontal banner.

Titanium grey with black and bright signal-lime accents. Precise micro-grid only on right quarter, abstract altimeter ring clipped by right edge, thick contemporary Korean headline on left 70%. Thin engineering measurement hairlines but no made-up numbers. Small HAMSAN and SINCE 2021. High-performance outdoor gear look, incredibly clean.

Three huge flat mountain triangles forming a memorable stepped triptych symbol on left in terracotta, sand, and dark navy. Warm white ground. Korean name on right in confident black humanist sans; year in small aligned right column. Bauhaus outdoor identity with outstanding space and proportions, no textures.

Elegant wide panoramic sunset landscape with a restrained burnt-orange sky and near-black pine ridge only along bottom quarter. Huge refined warm ivory Korean headline centered against clean sky. Small symmetrical typographic frame with HAMSAN and year. Fine pale sun disk positioned to far right. Cinematic, poised, no tourist-poster excess.

Editorial object photography: beautiful weathered olive technical hiking backpack carefully side-lit on warm neutral backdrop, isolated on right quarter. Left area spotless eggshell with huge dark graphite Korean wordmark and small copper labels. Backpack is not a product ad; it is one symbolic material object anchoring a club identity. Extremely tasteful typography and vast negative space.

Minimal contemporary identity on pale cool grey. A proprietary double-path equals-like graphic in forest green placed above-left of a huge dense Korean name. Two continuous curved paths travel horizontally through bottom quarter and converge on right. Tagline placed in negative space above paths. Typography-first optimistic communal hiking spirit, no people.

Premium expedition aesthetic with brushed silver-grey background subtle horizontal material grain and black oversized angular Korean lettering. A tiny polished chrome triangular mountain sculpture on left. Center-right horizontal composition. Thin black divider, small HAMSAN letterspaced and year in fine sans. Quiet futuristic look without neon or gaming style.

Warm ivory background, one narrow panoramic photograph strip of misty forest canopy across lower third, full bleed. Massive deep green Korean logotype across clean upper area; tiny year and English name form balanced margins. Modern architecture-studio-like outdoor brand, exceptionally restrained photo and type hierarchy.

Muted powder blue background, vibrant deep red typography. Precisely drawn red carabiner and rope line form an unusual abstract mountain monogram on left quarter. Korean club name on right in strong custom rounded geometric type, red hairline separating small slogan. Cool contemporary climbing club editorial graphics, no retail insignia.

Warm handmade ivory paper texture with bold black woodcut mountain engraving occupying right third, limited rust-orange stamp-like square accent WITHOUT Korean characters. On left, exceptionally crafted strong Korean serif logotype, modern editorial typesetting. The contrast of traditional Korean mountain woodcut and premium modern branding, no brush calligraphy.

Almost-white alpine snow landscape, sparse grey Korean granite mountain outlines far horizon and a single tiny red trail marker far right. Large black condensed Korean name left-center. Huge negative space and discreet small HAMSAN and year, short black tagline. Scandinavian outdoor editorial elegance, exceptional crisp contrast.

Warm navy background and cream bold Korean typography. Three broad diagonal trail stripes in orange, pale blue and cream confined to left quarter, reminiscent of woven technical webbing. Name in long uninterrupted line across right area, tight custom kerning. Vintage technical apparel identity reinterpreted with modern minimal composition.

Warm terracotta background with pale peach text. A large architectural arch at right reveals a very minimal layered mountain landscape, nuanced analog print texture. Text flush-left in elegant Korean geometric sans across left 70%. Minimal HAMSAN label, deliberate typographic alignment, inviting sophisticated travel-and-outdoor lifestyle brand.

Bold ivory on dark racing green. Place a small finely crafted circular crest at left, containing only a highly reduced two-person trail/mountain symbol and English HAMSAN, no clutter. Giant Korean headline outside crest to its right, large tracking for strength. Thin ivory horizontal borders, small orange dot detail. Professional established club identity.

Acid yellow-green background with huge black modern Korean display logotype leaning very slightly forward, with bespoke directional cuts in outer terminals but all syllables exactly readable. One fine energetic black trail line below name, compact black HAMSAN and year aligned upper corners. Modern athletic performance brand; no people, no gradients, no clutter.

Elegant botanical field-guide identity. Warm ecru with meticulously drawn dark green Korean pine branches entering from outer corners only, delicate copper accent. Strong graceful Korean serif name across middle; small HAMSAN and year above, tagline below. Refined engraving detail with generous empty center, no floral wedding styling.

Modern Swiss wayfinding: a vermilion rectangular flag icon on thin black pole as abstract summit signal on left; huge black Korean neo-grotesk headline right, very pale grey ground. Strong horizontal black baseline, small red year block. Sophisticated asymmetrical editorial layout, very bold simple identity.

Cinematic nocturnal Korean mountain silhouette in bottom third, dark ink blue open sky, fine subtle stars. One graceful moving headlamp light trail on mountain lower-right. Large ivory Korean logotype across center clear sky, small silver tagline. Tiny signal orange HAMSAN label top-left. Restrained premium expedition aesthetic, no sci-fi.

Warm white base. Proprietary interlocking angular two-mountain logo in royal purple and copper sits on left. Bold black Korean sans club name on right two-thirds. Fine purple hairline underlining name, tasteful serif tagline. Intelligent custom mark about togetherness and ascent, mature confident studio branding, no gradients.

Wide poetic stylized landscape illustration in quiet olive, sage, cream and muted golden ochre. A thin winding trail through abstract rolling Korean peaks takes bottom half, three extremely tiny hikers at far right add scale. Upper half remains clear cream for beautiful huge dark green Korean name, centered tagline below name. Book-cover quality, flat print texture, serene premium club identity.

Create an exceptional custom Korean two-syllable logotype '함산' HUGE on left-center, deep black on bone white, muscular geometric typography with one tiny mountain notch. English HAMSAN in large but secondary elegant grotesk on right, below a fine horizontal mountain ridge line. Vermilion tiny summit dot. Slogan aligned low left and year low right. Flagship minimalist identity, substantial whitespace.

Racing green ground, cream typography, huge memorable abstract H-shaped twin summit symbol left, enormous Korean '함산' right in bold custom geometric lettering. Small HAMSAN beneath name with disciplined wide tracking, fine horizontal amber line and founding year. Great proportions of emblem and wordmark, modern premium outdoor brand.

Vintage luxury mountain journal. Deep burgundy text on warm parchment. Huge Korean '함산' in crafted high-contrast serif, accompanied by very large condensed English HAMSAN on right half, two text blocks connected by fine engraved horizontal ridge. Tiny ornate but restrained star as center divider. Editorial heritage identity, beautiful typesetting not a retro badge.

Massive black two-syllable '함산' custom rounded block wordmark on vivid orange ground, typography fills center 65% banner height but retains generous margins. Left a simple ivory angular rock-stack symbol, right small upright HAMSAN. Tagline clean black along bottom; year top right. Bold iconic bouldering brand, graphic purity.

Premium ethereal photograph of layered misty blue-grey Korean mountains. Huge refined white Korean '함산' centered, exceptionally beautiful strong Korean serif rather than sans. Letterspaced HAMSAN directly beneath in clean modern sans, tagline lower center, year upper right. A single tiny ivory circular summit symbol upper left. Calm cinematic editorial campaign.

Ivory base, black and cobalt details. Giant proprietary letter H constructed from delicate contour lines at left, not thick filled typography; huge dense Korean '함산' centered-right. Asymmetric modern grid, small cobalt English HAMSAN near top and year at bottom right. Map art as sophisticated monogram; tagline perfectly legible below Korean.

Deep graphite background. One continuous bright lime climbing rope curves into a subtle two-peak silhouette across left third, rendered as clean elegant graphic line. Huge ivory modern Korean '함산' on middle-right, small HAMSAN beneath with generous tracking. Slogan along bottom, year top left. Technical understated contemporary identity.

Retro-modern premium woven hiking label feeling in ochre, dark navy and cream, rendered FLAT artwork without mockup. One large clean rounded rectangular patch outline contains tiny mountain symbol left and huge Korean '함산' middle, English HAMSAN in right side stacked typographic field. Fine stitching only at border, not everywhere. Tagline below main name and year at upper margin. Restrained artisanal gear brand.

Warm chalk background. Giant abstract stacked mountain shapes in clay, sand and charcoal at far right with a small rust-red rising sun. Huge beautifully sculpted dark charcoal Korean '함산' on left, HAMSAN below in widely spaced grotesk, refined tagline at bottom. Contemporary art gallery outdoor lifestyle, incredibly generous space and tactile screenprint subtlety.

Ultramarine blue background, giant warm white Korean '함산' across center-left in bespoke angular athletic typography, English HAMSAN large outlined letters on right integrated with a single minimalist jagged white ridge. Fine white baseline and tagline low center, SINCE 2021 upper-left. Iconic bold modern expedition identity with disciplined spacing and no textures.

refinements.instruction: Preserve photo and all layout; replace only tagline with clear white Korean sans-serif: 함께 가는 길, 함께 오르는 산. Ensure 르 consists of ㄹ and horizontal ㅡ with no vertical stem.
